items.exampleEn: He filled the tub with hot water and relaxed for an hour.
items.exampleZh: 他在浴缸裡放滿熱水，放鬆了一個小時。

items.exampleEn: Every winter, someone has to clean the ashes out of the fireplace.
items.exampleZh: 每年冬天，都得有人把壁爐裡的灰清乾淨。

items.exampleEn: The singer adjusted the height of her stool before the show began.
items.exampleZh: 演出開始前，歌手調整了她凳子的高度。

items.exampleEn: A tall hedge separates the school from the busy road.
items.exampleZh: 一排高高的樹籬把學校和繁忙的馬路隔開。

items.exampleEn: This old bridge has three tall arches over the river.
items.exampleZh: 這座古橋在河上有三個高大的橋拱。

items.exampleEn: We spent a cozy evening at home playing cards.
items.exampleZh: 我們在家打牌，度過了一個溫馨的夜晚。

items.exampleEn: The children in the story were afraid of the dark cellar under the castle.
items.exampleZh: 故事裡的孩子們很怕城堡底下那間陰暗的地窖。

items.exampleEn: The kids built a spaceship out of cardboard and tape.
items.exampleZh: 孩子們用紙板和膠帶做了一艘太空船。

items.exampleEn: Volunteers picked up litter along the river on Sunday.
items.exampleZh: 志工們星期天沿著河邊撿垃圾。

items.sentenceEn: Please don't litter; there is a trash can right over there.
items.sentenceZh: 請不要亂丟垃圾，那邊就有垃圾桶。

items.audioEn: We keep the potatoes and apples in the cellar because it stays cool all year.
items.audioZh: 我們把馬鈴薯和蘋果放在地窖裡，因為那裡一年四季都很涼。
items.questionZh: 為什麼把食物放在地窖？
options: It is close to the kitchen
It is easy to keep clean

items.sentenceEn: My little sister loves taking long baths in the tub.
items.sentenceZh: 我妹妹很喜歡在浴缸裡泡很久的澡。

items.sentenceEn: Bad weather is coming, so let's sit by the fireplace and read.
items.sentenceZh: 壞天氣要來了，我們坐在壁爐旁看書吧。

items.stemEn: Our new apartment is small but ____, with soft lights and warm colors.
items.stemZh: 我們的新公寓雖小但很溫馨，有柔和的燈光和溫暖的色調。

items.stemEn: He sat on a tall ____ at the kitchen counter and drank his coffee.
items.stemZh: 他坐在廚房流理台旁的高腳椅上喝咖啡。

items.passageEn: When my grandparents moved to a smaller house, our whole family came to help. We packed books and dishes into cardboard boxes and carried old jam jars up from the cellar. The house was cozy, with a brick fireplace in the living room and a green hedge around the garden. A stone arch stood over the front gate, covered in climbing roses with a sweet fragrance. My cousin found an old metal tub in the shed and turned it into a flower pot. At the end of the day, we cleared up all the mess, sat on wooden stools in the kitchen, and shared a pot of soup.
items.passageZh: 爺爺奶奶搬到比較小的房子時，我們全家都來幫忙。我們把書和碗盤裝進紙箱，還從地窖搬上來一些舊果醬罐。那間房子很溫馨，客廳裡有座磚砌壁爐，花園四周圍著綠色樹籬。前門上方立著一座石拱門，上面爬滿了香氣甜美的玫瑰。表哥在小屋裡找到一個舊鐵桶，把它改成了花盆。一天結束時，我們把屋裡收拾乾淨，坐在廚房的木凳子上，一起分享一鍋湯。

questions.questionZh: 表哥把舊鐵桶改成了什麼？
這間房子的花園四周有什麼？

items.promptZh: 請把這些空紙箱壓扁再拿去回收。
referenceEn: Please press these empty cardboard boxes flat before you recycle them.
Please make these cardboard boxes flat before recycling them.
rubricZh: cardboard 可當形容詞用（例如 cardboard boxes 等）
「壓扁」可寫，例如 flatten、make… flat、fold 等；「回收」可寫，例如 recycle 等

items.promptZh: 我們的鄰居每個月修剪一次樹籬。
referenceEn: Our neighbor cuts the hedge once a month.
Our neighbor trims the hedge every month.
rubricZh: hedge 指「樹籬」（例如 the hedge、their hedge 等）
「修剪」可寫，例如 cut、trim 等；主詞單數時動詞加 s
「每個月一次」可寫，例如 once a month、every month 等
